name: Mirelurk Egg
blurb: Every harvestable world spawn for Mirelurk Eggs, grouped by region. Hatching egg clutches are not mapped — they cannot be picked up. Directions and photos are added by hand.

world_spawns.note: Harvestable mirelurk egg clutches are placed throughout the world; each activation guarantees 1 mirelurk egg. The similar-looking hatching egg clutches are a different activator — they only spawn a mirelurk hatchling and give you no egg, so they are not mapped here.

whitespring.note: Whitespring food vendor can stock 1 mirelurk egg from its rare food pool (per-reset chance computed).

consumption.note: Mirelurk Egg is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
